title: Law-text captures the readings named as missing: ZR 23-343; 23-43 with 23-434 to 23-436; 23-41 and its sections; 34-112, 34-113, 34-21; 35-62, 35-64, 35-71 and its sections, 36-64; eleven ZR 12-10 definitions - source text only (D-090 R291)
objective: Capture, as source text only, the law text that the independent readings and the captures of tasks M4-T025, M4-T026 and M4-T027 named as needed and not captured. From the official Zoning Resolution site (zoningresolution.planning.nyc.gov), with the capture method and file format of task M4-T026 (each section WHOLE; each request's own time; the print/PDF as a text check; labels from a channel that prints them, or disclosed as positions in the page's markup): (1) ZR 23-343 (rear yard equivalents for through lots); (2) ZR 23-434 and ZR 23-435 and ZR 23-436 and the text of ZR 23-43 itself (the height and setback sections the overlay text and ZR 23-362(b) point to); (3) ZR 23-41 and every section numbered under it that the official page shows (permitted obstructions, pointed to by ZR 35-53); (4) ZR 34-112 and ZR 34-113 and ZR 34-21 (the neighbours of the captured 34-11 family and the range ZR 34-11 names); (5) ZR 35-62, ZR 35-64, ZR 35-71 with every section under it, and ZR 36-64 (pointed to by ZR 34-24 and ZR 35-63); (6) the ZR 12-10 definitions of 'lot line, front', 'lot line, rear', 'lot line, side', 'lot width', 'lot depth', 'zoning lot', 'street line', 'residential', 'Manhattan Core', 'base plane' and, if ZR 12-10 defines it, 'Special Downtown Brooklyn District' (if it is defined elsewhere, the report says where and it is not captured here). One file per section and one per 12-10 defined term. A capture holds source text only: no rule, no reading for a lot, no derived number. No existing capture is edited. Anything that cannot be read in full is said so in the capture and the report; nothing is filled from memory, a lead or another site. No rule file, rule engine, register entry, reference case or screen changes.
business_reason: The reference cases keep rows 'not known' for want of this text (the through-lot rear yard, ZR 23-343; the eligible-site maximum of ZR 23-362(b), ZR 23-434; which lot line is the rear lot line and what the lot width is; whether the test lot is in a special density area), the measurement record keeps the base of the amenity allowance 'not sure' ('residential floor area'), and the overlay text points to sections that are not captured. Step 3 of the owner's eight steps (R291): the text must be captured before any missing rule can be resolved.
